verify.description: Run the full local CI wall
verify.template: Run `pnpm ai:check`, `pnpm ci:local`, `pnpm audit --audit-level high` and `pnpm e2e`. Report each result. Do not claim success without the command output.

protected-audit.template: Read `.ai/rules/frontend.md`, `.ai/rules/testing.md` and `.opencode/skills/webapp-testing/SKILL.md`. Audit the translator and extension changes for protected-value drift, add missing tests, and run `pnpm --filter @zteam/translator test`.

project-sync.template: Read `docs/PROJECT_BOARD.md`. Update `scripts/project-plan.json` if needed, then run `node scripts/bootstrap-github-project.mjs`. Report created or updated items. Do not delete anything without explicit approval.

release-check.template: Read `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `.ai/rules/repo.md` and `.opencode/skills/git-commit/SKILL.md`. Run `pnpm ci:local`, `pnpm audit --audit-level high`, `pnpm e2e`, `pnpm package`, `pnpm size:check` and verify the ZIP and checksums.
